about: How a fight crosses between the two games. Numbers here are generated into ptr-plugin/src/Gen/Sheets.cs and used by Combat.cs; the tunable ones are also settings.

columns.verified: Evidence from a real run, or 'no'

rows.rule: PTR people within this distance are hittable in Minecraft
Hitbox width of a standing person
Hitbox width of a person lying down (knocked out or dead)
Hitbox height of a person lying down
A Minecraft critical hit (falling) hits harder in PTR
The first hit on a calm person starts PTR's brawl in this radius
rows.verified: 2026-10-09: the bar joined the fight after the first hits

rows.rule: Minecraft damage from which PTR plays its strong hurt sound
PTR impact force per point of Minecraft knockback above an ordinary hit's (PTR's own pushes are 5-30: TestKnockbackX10/X30/Away5, Beneath melee 5, charge 10)
rows.verified: 2026-10-10: at 60 per point + 20 per damage point (up to 170 a hit) PTR's people jumped ('teleporting') and Beneath's flew off

rows.rule: Minecraft knockback an ordinary hit has (0.4, a sprint hit 0.9): hits up to this don't push, they flinch in place as PTR's punches do
Force handed to PTR's Damage per (0.5 + Minecraft knockback): how hard a knocked-out body falls
SkyCraft's Minecraft side divides hurt values by this (Skyrim scale), in hundredths
rows.verified: 2026-10-09: PTR hit arrived as Minecraft damage
